note: Per-config treatment for the NeoForge 1.21.1 migration (plan Phase 5). Ordered rules: the first match decides. 'regenerate' files were reconciled at the first clean target boot (Phase 6, pack-test boot 6, 2026-10-30): no shipped value was reset by a mod; 87 files where the 1.21.1 mods dropped obsolete keys or added new ones were replaced by the files those mods wrote back (our values kept), and no dropped key carried Evil Eye intent (each differed from the pack's initial defaults only where a mod had written its own default). Client-only defaults that a server cannot generate wait for the owner's first launch. tools/packwiz/tests/config_decisions.test.cjs enforces full coverage.

Evil Eye Essentials 0.1.0 replaces FTB Essentials (wave 5). Carries defaultconfigs/ftbessentials-server.snbt's intent: 3 homes, 60-second cooldowns for /home, /back, /spawn and /tpa, /rtp off, fly/god/heal/feed/extinguish/speed on; everything else FTB Essentials 2101.1.10's defaults (warp 10 s, /back max 10). Bytes are the NeoForge-written default file (the defaults equal the pack values).

Evil Eye Tweaks 0.4.0 replaces Fuel Goes Here and Double Doors (doors on, gates and trapdoors off, recursive on, distance 10, empty blacklist: the Double Doors 7.5 values), adds the pick-up receipt and food snapshot producers for Evil Eye Client (both on), and wave 4: AttributeFix maxima, Companion defaults (= config/companion-common.yaml), FallingTree values from config/fallingtree.json, Flat Bedrock, Hourglass day 0.5/night 1.0/weather SLEEPING, Clumps on, Let Me Despawn values (corpse:corpse kept, spawner and trial-spawner despawn on). Bytes are the NeoForge-written default file (LF; the defaults equal the pack values), so the mod does not rewrite it. Wave 3 adds [crafting] (crafting actions on, compress needs a crafting grid, denylist sandstone and iron trapdoor: the config/craftingtweaks-common.toml values).

Evil Eye Client 0.2.0 replaces Yeetus Experimentus, Pick Up Notifier, Stylish Effects, Colorful Hearts, Enchantment Descriptions and AppleSkin (wave 2) and Better Advancements, Mouse Tweaks and Crafting Tweaks' client options (wave 3: [advancements], [gestures], [recipeBook] hideButton, carried from config/betteradvancements-client.toml, config/MouseTweaks.cfg and config/craftingtweaks-common.toml [client]; the crafting keys were removed in 0.3.2) and FTB Library's sidebar (wave 5: [sidebar], from config/sidebar_buttons.json and ftblibrary-client.snbt's layout). Bytes are the NeoForge-written default file (LF; the defaults equal the pack values), so the mod does not rewrite it.
